criteria.requirement: Implement jmespath.queries.QuerySet(queries,*,options=None,errors="raise") and frozen QueryResult (status,value,error_type,error,phase). Compile the ordered name->expression mapping once via BoundExpression; raise is default, collect preserves individual compile/evaluate JMESPath errors while other queries continue. search(data) returns ordered name->result with phase compile/evaluate/complete and status error/passed. Do not capture unrelated programmer exceptions or retain traceback objects. Query and result-container mutations must not change later searches; standard null remains a successful None value. Use completed variadic validation and literal/option binding for reliable repeated evaluation.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
